propositions: Auto-deploy restart during in-flight review times out the shutdown drain (45s) before the review completes (260-911s), causing worker cancellation and fail-closed -1 vote that blocks backfill reconciler recovery
Drain timeout constant (45s) is much smaller than review timeout (1200s); raising drain to 1200s and compose stop_grace_period to 1320s allows in-flight reviews to complete without interruption

Retryable coverage gaps (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled) should defer without voting to remain eligible for backfill reconciler re-drive, while terminal outcomes (indeterminate, finding) continue to vote -1
After N consecutive retryable failures on the same (change_id, revision), escalate by casting fail-closed -1 with exhaustion note and emitting VOTER_ERROR alarm
New review_attempts table tracks retry budget per (change_id, revision) independent of voted ledger, allowing vote-less deferral and reset semantics for contributor re-trigger
Teardown-corrupted review during drain is discriminated via CancelledError and treated as retryable no-vote rather than fail-closed, with quiesce pattern preventing most cancellations
